author: Inside Edition
description: Much of the United States is a frozen land of lakes and rivers. Video shows a coyote in the Boston Harbor trying to navigate the ice. In New York City's Central Park, a coyote was spotted crossing a frozen pond. There are large chunks of ice in the Hudson River but be warned. Experts say just because the ice looks solid, it does not mean it is safe to walk on. Matt James, TV's Bachelor from five years ago, took a video of a boat stuck in the water.
title: Experts Warn Ice Is Not Always Safe To Walk On

author: Inside Edition
description: A woman abandoned a dog at a stranger's house. Dason Garner says she saw the video of the dog on a Facebook posting. Garner, a veterinarian assistant, says she drove to the neighborhood and found the poodle mix. Garner says the animal control office asked her to hand over the dog but she was afraid the dog would meet a grim fate. To her surprise, Garner was later criminally charged with failure to surrender the dog.
title: Veterinarian Assistant Charged After Rescuing Abandoned Dog

author: Inside Edition
description: Savannah Guthrie's brother, Camron Guthrie, made a fresh appeal to their mother's kidnapper. Camron, a 61-year-old retired F-16 fighter pilot, posted the video on Instagram as the 5 p.m. deadline passed that had been set by the kidnappers. The ransom demand sent to three news organizations opened with "Nancy is ok but scared," and warned, "You will have no way of contacting me. This is the only contact." New details have been released about the kidnapping timeline.
title: 1st Deadline In Alleged Ransom Note To Guthrie Family Passes

author: Inside Edition
description: Some health experts are saying not to give up on Nancy Guthrie as older people are surprisingly resilient. Older people tend to be better problem solvers and have better emotional regulation than young people that can be crucial in traumatic situations. Nancy Guthrie also has a pacemaker implant that regulates her heartbeat. The pacemaker is connected to a phone by Bluetooth but even though it lost connection, it still works well.
title: Can Nancy Guthrie's Advanced Age Help Her Survive?

author: Inside Edition
description: Bad Bunny has been facing backlash from conservatives angry over his stance on ICE raids and the fact that he sings mostly in Spanish. As he takes the state at Levi's Stadium on Sunday night, there will be a competing concert headlined by Kid Rock called "The All-American Halftime Show." There is buzz over who Bad Bunny will bring on a special guest stars. 46 percent of odds makers predict it will be Cardi B.
title: Will Bad Bunny Bring A Special Guest For Super Bowl Halftime Show?

author: Inside Edition
description: Elizabeth Smart is a well-known kidnapping survivor. Now her father, Ed Smart, is offering to help Savannah Guthrie's family as he coincidentally lives in Tucson, where Nancy Guthrie was abducted. Elizabeth was 14 years old in 2002 when she was abducted from her bedroom. Nine months later, she was found alive after her captor forced her to become his bride. Inside Edition's Jim Moret also spoke to John Ramsey, who wrongly came under scrutiny after his daughter JonBenet was found slain.
title: Dad Of Elizabeth Smart Speaks Out Amid Nancy Guthrie's Disappearance

author: Inside Edition
description: Rusty Hunter is a diver and photographer. It's not the type of hobby where he expected to make friends, but to his surprise, a little white seal seemed to take an interest in him. He tells KCBS he's seen the same seal on at least a dozen different dives. While she was wary at first, he says now she freely approaches him. Hunter says he knows how rare and special it is to have formed a bond with this sea creature. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Photographer Befriends Seal He Sees Often While Diving For Photos

author: Inside Edition
description: Bodycam video shows a police officer shoot a man coming at him holding a knife. The NYPD says officers were dispatched to a house requesting an ambulance for someone having a mental health episode. When officers were let into the home, the suspect can be seen walking toward them with a knife in his hand. After he ignored several commands to drop the knife, and having pushed through a door separating him and the officers, an officer fired on him. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: NYPD Officer Shoots Man Coming Toward Him With Knife

author: Inside Edition
description: Two teenage sisters were trapped in an overturned SUV after cops say a car crashed into their vehicle. A police officer on the scene smashed the window to rescue the victims before more police and firefighters rushed to the scene. The girls' father arrived and gave them big hugs. Inside Edition spoke to Zoe, 16, and Grace Klimis, 14. Inside Edition also spoke to hero officer William Volker. This week, the sisters got to thank the officer in person as he was given an award for his good deed.
title: Officer Rescues Teenage Sisters Trapped In Overturned SUV

author: Inside Edition
description: During a press conference on Thursday, the Puerto Rican-born artist said he wants people to have fun and dance during the show.
title: What Will Bad Bunny Say At The Super Bowl? #shorts
